boundary_heuristic: Each layer ends at the smallest slice that unlocks a new responsible decision with current evidence.
claim_ceiling: This implementation layering guides candidate construction only. It is not an execution registry, admission decision, activation plan, or migration authority.

layers.decision_question: After this layer, we know whether existing Lab artifact mechanics can reconstruct one cross-family normalized slice without identity or authority collapse.
layers.minimum_working_unit: One D65 Definition, five Artifact Types, two evaluation profiles, reused relations, hostile fixtures, and exact source bindings.
layers.name: D65 dependency-closed vertical
layers.promotion_decision: Continue to L1 only on deterministic PASS with no source drift.

layers.decision_question: After this layer, we know whether candidate Definition reconstruction is repeatable across the remaining semantic targets.
layers.minimum_working_unit: Batch-independent Definition candidates with voice, source, index, and drift closure.
layers.name: Semantic-family repeatability
layers.promotion_decision: Continue when every semantic candidate is independently reproducible.

layers.decision_question: After this layer, we know whether Artifact Types, profiles, relation kinds, and derived surfaces can be reconstructed without redundant canonical axes.
layers.minimum_working_unit: Family-specific schemas and dependency-ordered target batches.
layers.name: Cross-family reconstruction
layers.promotion_decision: Continue when all 195 target identities have explicit realization evidence or typed residue.

layers.decision_question: After this layer, we know whether approved ontology routes can form bounded contexts that evolve and recover without losing source lineage.
layers.minimum_working_unit: One context vertical with map, bindings, evolution, rollback, and recovery tests.
layers.name: Context reconstruction and recovery
layers.promotion_decision: Prepare one product candidate for review; do not infer admission.
